paite: Ka tapa, ka dan mangngilh ke'n; himahleh ka thupiakte na lungtang in kem hen.
heading: Tuailaite Kiang A Thuhilhna

paite: Nite sawtna leh damsung kumte leh muanna, nang a hong kibehlap ding ahi ngal a.
Zahngaihna leh thutak in nang hon nuse kei hen; na ngawng kimvel in vial inla; na lungtang dohkan tung ah amaute gelh in.
Huchi in Pathian leh mihing mitmuh in deihsakna leh theihsiamna hoih na mu ding hi.
Na lungtang tengteng toh TOUPA ah muang inla, nangmah theihsiamna ah kinga ke'n.
Na lampi tengteng ah amah thei inla, huchi in ama'n na lampite apitang ding hi.
Nangmah mit ah pil ke'nla; TOUPA kihta inla, gilou taisan in.
Na lai a ding in damna ahi ding a, na guhte a ding in guhngek.
Na van in TOUPA zahtak in, na punna tengteng a gah masate toh in.
Huchi in hauhna in na pangte adimlet dia, na belte uain thak in adimlet ding hi.
Ka tapa, TOUPA sawina musit ke'nla; abawlhoihna leng chimtak sam ke'n.
Pa'n akipahna tapa asalh bang in; TOUPA'N a-itte asal ngal a.
Pilna mumi leh theihsiamna mumi'n nuam asa hi.
Huai a vante lah dangka vante sang in ahoihzaw ngal a, huan huai a punna dangka- eng hoih sang in.
Rubi suang sang in amanphazaw; huan amah toh na thil deihte na tehpih thei kei ding.
Akhut taklam ah nite sawtna a-om a; akhut veilam ah hauhsaknate leh zahtakhuaina.
Alampite nopna lampite ahi a, alampite tengteng muanna ahi.
Amah len tintente a ding in hinna sing ahi; amah nei den michih in nuam asa uhi.
TOUPA'N pilna in lei amukhia a; theihsiamna in vante ahihkipta hi.
Atheihna in thuknate akitam a, huan vante'n adaitui ataksak uhi.
Ka tapa, na mitte a kipan amaute paimangsak ke'n; pilna hoih leh ngentelna kem gige in.
Huchi in na kha a ding in hinna ahi ding ua, na ngawng a ding in kilawmna.
Huchi in bittak in na lampi ah na pai ding a, na khe akisui kei ding hi.
Na lup chiang in, na lau kei dia; ahi, na lum ding a, na ihmut alim ding.
Lauguihna kihta ke'n, ahong pai chiang in, giloute hihgawpna leng lau sam ke'n.
TOUPA na kimuanna ahi sin ngal a, na khe thang a awk lou ding in aveng ding hi.
Amu dingte a kipan thil hoih it ke'n, hih ding a na khut thilhihtheihna a-om lai in.
Na invengte kiang ah, na kiang a na neih lai in, pai inla, hong nawn in, huchi in zingsang chiang in ka hon pe ding, chi ke'n.
Na invengte siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah ke'n, na kiang ah bittak in ateng chih thei in.
Aziak bei in mi toh kina ke'n, gilou bangmah na tung a ahihkeileh.
Hiamgammi eng ke'n, alampite bangmah tel ke'n.
Kilawm lou lah TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi ngal a; himahleh athuguk mitangte kiang ah a-om hi.
TOUPA hamsia migiloute inn ah a-om; himahleh midiktatte tenna avualzawl hi.
Ama'n nuihsan hatte anuihsan a, himahleh kingainiamte kiang ah hehpihna apia hi.
Mipil in thupina gou aluah ding; himahleh zumna mihaite kaisanna ahi ding hi.
